notes.title: Across is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193284/742a4b103823fcb519cc590cc37b82c0a7698c09.jpg[/img]

Explore a world filled with mystery, ruins and unknown creatures as you reveal the memories of the Cub’s owner Estelle and her parents as they make their way to the city while a war approaches the kingdom.

After a year and a half, it is finally out!

We are very proud to present you Across!
I hope you enjoy it as much as we do making it, it was a lot of hurdles and problems with tons of bugs 

See the continent of Flihela and whats behind the events that occurred on it!

[previewyoutube=karl2UJ4bpU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: ACROSS IS COMING!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=karl2UJ4bpU;full][/previewyoutube][b]We are back and with big news![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193284/ae21c22e1ffccb6c3fc188b715af33cd515b0581.gif[/img]

Our apologies for the huge delay. firstly the game was more than we expected and did a lot of testing to make sure the corners of the game are flawless! As you can see in the gifs we did a lot of improvements since we went dark With great feedback from the community, we have heard you along with our vision and we are very proud to deliver you Across!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193284/0ad3f233152c9e2c7e8b463ca03ea61bf3baae41.gif[/img]

Again we deeply apologize for the colossal delay, but we made sure this is a trade-off for the quality of the game, The community has been really helpful and supportive of the development of the game and we can't wait for everyone to play it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193284/8344640582f1551bb4b32a4b0528acce1e5b7e64.gif[/img]


[b]Wait no longer we will travel ACROSS the continent of Flihela and beyond![/b]

The Adventure Starts On July 18, 2022!

notes.title: Across Demo out now and Open for feedback
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193284/ca4b165194a0e26927d9f312df0173fc35f92752.jpg[/img]

You can Play The Demo for Across now! Leave your thoughts, Opinions, Feedback. It helps a lot and helps improve the game!

Explore the Continent of Svirall and Flihela and Unravel the mystery behind the attack on Gantrick while a family flees from the war.
